QUOTE: **Persistence:** "Always Allow/Deny" writes the pattern into `permissions.allow` or `permissions.deny` in the project YAML through `PermissionPersister` (read-modify-write).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says decisions are persisted to the project YAML via PermissionPersister, but it never names config.local.yaml. It also doesn't contrast persistence with the in-memory add_permission call.
